name: info-grid
title: Info Grid
description: A configurable card-based grid layout with automatic dividers and corner rounding. Cells accept any children — compose with KeyIcon, Badge, or any custom content.

docs.lead: A configurable card-based grid layout with automatic dividers and corner rounding. Only provides the structural shell (Root, Row, Cell) — compose cell content freely with KeyIcon, Badge, text, or any custom elements.

api.name: InfoGrid.Root
api.description: The card container with rounded corners, border, and shadow. Uses overflow-hidden so corner cells clip automatically.

api.name: InfoGrid.Row
api.description: A horizontal row of cells. Automatically adds a top divider for all rows except the first.

api.name: InfoGrid.Cell
api.description: An individual cell. Automatically adds a right divider for all cells except the last in a row. Place any content as children — KeyIcon, badges, tags, text, or custom elements.

api.name: InfoGrid.Group
api.description: A composed component that renders a complete grid from an array of row definitions. Each row contains items with a KeyIcon, label, and children.

props.name: rows
props.description: Array of row definitions. Each row has `items` with `icon`, `label`, and `children`.
